thread:
Priya: kicking off intake for new community model 'hyperlight-3b'. artifacts: weights(.pt), tokenizer.json, merges, vocab. Need provenance, signed checksums, registry path, and a recommended quantization plan. Could someone pick this up?

acq-bot: Please upload all artifacts to s3://redwood-inbound/hyperlight-3b/<version>/ and include a manifest.json with sha256 and signer info. See https://redwood.internal/model-acq for schema. Required fields: filename, size_bytes, sha256, signed_by, upload_time.

Alice C.: I'll handle initial tokenizer checks. Quick ask: was the tokenizer trained with byte-level BPE or standard BPE? That affects merges.

Priya: author said "byte-bpe" in the repo README but no tokenizer config attached. We need to verify. Also need a deterministic roundtrip test (text -> tokens -> detokenize) across ~10k real sentences.

Mateo: I'll generate the roundtrip harness. Plan: run on a stratified sample (docs/dev/bench/corpora). Command I usually use:
```bash
python -m evals.tokenizer_roundtrip --tok tokenizer.json --input sample.txt --out artifacts/roundtrip-report.json
```
Include a checksum of tokenizer files before/after upload.

Priya: +1. Also add a tiny script to validate merges/vocab order; mismatched merges often break detach.

acq-bot: Checklist reminder:
- manifest.json present with sha256 for every file
- artifacts uploaded to s3 path above
- access policy set to redwood-inbound:read-write (temporary)
- signer identity recorded (github org or GPG)
- provenance note attached to ticket #ML-4923

Jordan: I'll take weights validation and quantization experiment. Suggest quant paths: q4_0 and q8_0 baseline using our quant bench. I'll spin up q4_0 runs on dedicated-dev GPU pool. Expected perf hit metrics: ~1.6x latency improvement, <1.5% eval-perf delta on common tasks but we'll measure.

Sam: On evals side: prepare a small suite: lm perplexity (wikitext), instruct-chat alignment (our chat-eval), embedding-drift (cosine on anchor set). We need to compare FP16 baseline -> q8 -> q4. Use this harness:
```bash
python -m evals.run --model-dir s3://redwood-inbound/hyperlight-3b/ --suites lm,chat,emb-drift --out results/hyperlight-3b-eval.json
```
Please tag runs with commit hash and manifest sha256.

Alice C.: Found tokenizer mismatch locally: tokenizer.json references merges_v2 but uploaded merges file is merges_v1. I pushed a note to the ticket. Whoever uploaded, can you reupload correct merges and update manifest?

Mateo: Re-uploading corrected merges now. New sha256: 9f2b3c... (pushing manifest update).

Priya: Good catch. After uploads, we'll require the following gating before scheduling dedicated quant jobs:
- manifest and signed_by present
- tokenizer roundtrip <0.1% tokenization error on sample
- weights file checksum verified against manifest
- small smoke run (generate 128 tokens) for memory/cuda errors

Jordan: I'll hold on heavy quant until the gates pass. Once green, I'll kick q8_0 then q4_0 and push logs to /artifacts/quant/hyperlight-3b/<run-id>

Priya: Also note we need to add a provenance paragraph in registry entry: source repo URL, author, license (OSS?), any dataset disclaimers. If license is unknown, we can't onboard for hosted-prod.

Sam: If license is unclear, we can still run private/dedicated evals but flag it in the registry and block hosted listing.

Priya: Thanks all. Action items: Alice - roundtrip + tokenizer diff; Mateo - manifest update + merges upload; Jordan - wait for gates; Sam - prep eval suites; I'll update ticket ML-4923 with gating checklist and mark priority P1 for onboarding. :white_check_mark:
